newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier to get more help from Ottawa.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier to get more help from Ottawa.

text.p: The government of Canada announced on Monday it would be extending more help to Bombardier Inc, despite the widespread criticism it drew over an interest-free loan it gave it less than two months ago.

Industry Minister John Manley's office said the minister would announce investment in research and development in de Havilland, in which the aerospace and transportation conglomerate Bombardier has a majority stake.

"The government of Canada's investment in the research and development phase of the project reflects a new approach to building Canada's economy and creating jobs through technology development," a statement said.

The deal was offered under the same Technology Partnerships Canada program under which a C$87 million investment was made in research and development in Bombardier's 70-passenger regional jet program in Quebec on October 21.
That provoked howls of outrage from opposition politicians, especially from western Canada.
